prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / character redesign. Asset type: NPC-01 revision 02, ONE full-body character concept source for Project RL, a grimdark cyberpunk roguelike rendered at 64px body height. Image 1 is the old NPC design to replace; image 2 is the accepted style/proportions reference. Preserve the series' compact FIVE-HEADS-tall adult game proportions, large readable gloved hands and boots, clean controlled dark outlines and broad flat comic-book cel-shading. No photorealism, no 3D, no tiny texture noise, no pink. Actual transparent background, no floor, no shadow, no lettering, one single nearly frontal standing figure and one pose only.
User correction: this mission authority MUST be an adult MAN, wearing a HELMET and visibly ARMED. He represents oppressive prison authority: the player is a disposable convicted prisoner, not a welcomed hero. His posture and clothes must communicate coercive authority and intimidation. Strong broad-shouldered masculine build and heavy grounded stance, not monstrous superhuman bulk. An original futuristic closed security helmet with heavy squared brow, a narrow opaque dark horizontal visor, angular reinforced cheeks, integrated ear armor, no exposed hair. Avoid any recognizable licensed helmet.
Redesign the uniform completely: knee-length severe charcoal-black penitentiary command coat, broad dull steel-grey reinforced chest and shoulder plates, large deep oxblood/burgundy coat panels to provide a visible second color, dark gloves, dark trousers, heavy squared black boots with grey toe guards. One simple ivory rectangular rank bar on breast and broad grey arm stripe; original fictional insignia only, no writing or real-world emblems. No decorative cape, no bright friendly yellow or blue, no gold heroic ornament, no fantasy spikes. Cold institutional authority, practical brutal cyberpunk equipment.
He holds ONE compact chunky industrial semiautomatic PISTOL in his RIGHT gloved hand (viewer left), lowered beside his thigh with muzzle pointing safely diagonally downward and outward, clearly attached to a normal-length arm. A real readable pistol shape: short squared barrel/slide, distinct trigger guard, grip visibly enclosed by palm and fingers; index finger resting along frame outside the guard. There must be clear hand-to-grip contact, no floating weapon and no second hand trying to hold it. The LEFT gloved hand is empty and held closed near the belt. Do not merge the gun silhouette into the coat or boot; leave negative space between them. No rifle, no sword, no shield.
Entire helmet, pistol muzzle, gloves and boot soles within generous transparent margins. This is a static armed-pose REVIEW CONCEPT, not a declaration that modular runtime weapon layers are already authored.
user_request: Un homme casqué et armé, uniforme pénitentiaire inquiétant et autoritaire. Le joueur demeure un détenu mal considéré, envoyé sous contrainte.
monsters_feedback: Le joueur apprécie les cinq modèles proposés. Cet avis ne définit pas les règles ni une intégration.
